"""Recompute every completed group of the continuation run from raw samples and archive the evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, statistics, gzip

r = Path.cwd()
base = r / '.work/partial-adoption-local-standard-20261117'
o = base / 'local'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protocol = json.loads((o / 'protocol.json').read_text())
plan = protocol['continuation_880']
results = json.loads((o / 'results.json').read_text())
start = json.loads((o / 'start.json').read_text())
assert start['protocol_sha256'] == sha(o / 'protocol.json') and start['controller_sha256'] == sha(base / 'run.py') == protocol['controller_sha256']
assert start['worker_sha256'] == sha(o / 'worker.py') == protocol['worker_sha256']
for name, digest in {**protocol['input_hashes'], **protocol['evidence_hashes']}.items():
    assert sha(r / name) == digest, name
for platform, paths in protocol['binary_paths'].items():
    for kind, path in paths.items():
        assert sha(r / path) == protocol['binary_hashes'][kind + '-' + platform]

groups, children, raw = {}, 0, {}
for path in sorted(list(o.glob('*-aa-?.json')) + list(o.glob('*-compare-?.json')) + list(o.glob('attempt-*/*-aa-?.json'))):
    d = json.loads(path.read_text())
    m = d['metadata']
    rounds = 5 if m['stage'] == 'aa' else 7
    arms = list(d['samples'])
    assert all(len(d['samples'][a]) == rounds for a in arms) and set(d['warmups_excluded']) == set(arms)
    assert all(x['checksum'] == d['config']['expected'] for a in arms for x in d['samples'][a] + [d['warmups_excluded'][a]])
    medians = {a: statistics.median(x['cpu_us'] for x in d['samples'][a]) for a in arms}
    a, c = (medians[k] for k in arms)
    assert medians == d['medians_us'] and abs(100 * abs(c - a) / min(a, c) - d['delta_percent']) < 1e-9 and abs(100 * (c / a - 1) - d['change_percent']) < 1e-9
    expected_orders = [arms if (i + m['series']) % 2 else arms[::-1] for i in range(rounds + 1)]
    assert d['orders'] == expected_orders and m['affinity'] == [2] and m['protocol_sha256'] == start['protocol_sha256']
    for session in d['cpu_queries']:
        for q in session['queries']:
            if q.get('child_affinity') is not None:
                assert q['child_affinity'] == [2]
    children += len(d['cpu_queries'])
    rel = path.relative_to(o).as_posix()
    raw[rel] = d
    groups[rel] = {'case': m['platform'] + '/' + m['case'], 'stage': m['stage'], 'series': m['series'],
                   'iterations': d['config']['iterations'], 'medians_us': medians, 'delta_percent': d['delta_percent'],
                   'change_percent': d['change_percent'], 'cpu_us': {k: [x['cpu_us'] for x in d['samples'][k]] for k in arms}}

# Recompute calibration and comparison verdicts for conditions measured in this run.
verdicts = {}
for case in plan['order']:
    for platform in ('windows', 'linux'):
        key = platform + '/' + case
        stem = f'{platform}-{case}'
        attempts = []
        for folder in ('attempt-1/', ''):
            aa = [groups.get(f'{folder}{stem}-aa-{i}.json') for i in (1, 2)]
            if all(aa):
                delta = max(x['delta_percent'] for x in aa)
                minimum = min(v for x in aa for v in x['medians_us'].values())
                attempts.append({'delta_percent': delta, 'minimum_median_us': minimum, 'passed': delta <= 2 and minimum >= 5000000})
        ab = [groups.get(f'{stem}-compare-{i}.json') for i in (1, 2)]
        entry = {'calibration_attempts_this_run': attempts}
        if all(ab):
            delta = attempts[-1]['delta_percent']
            cap = (10 if 'throw' in case else 5) if case.startswith('catch-') else max(3, 2 * delta)
            changes = [x['change_percent'] for x in ab]
            entry['comparison'] = {'changes_percent': changes, 'threshold_percent': cap, 'passed': all(v <= cap for v in changes)}
            assert results['comparisons'][key] == {'changes_percent': changes, 'delta_percent': delta, 'threshold_percent': cap, 'passed': entry['comparison']['passed']}
            assert attempts[-1]['passed']
        else:
            assert key not in results['comparisons']
        if attempts:
            stored = {k: results['calibrations'][key][k] for k in ('delta_percent', 'minimum_median_us', 'passed')}
            assert stored == attempts[-1], key
        verdicts[key] = entry

compared = [k for k, v in verdicts.items() if 'comparison' in v]
summary = {
    'date': '2026-11-17', 'task': 881, 'status': results['status'],
    'stopped_at': {'platform': results.get('platform'), 'case': results.get('case')},
    'start_utc': start['utc'], 'complete_utc': json.loads((o / 'complete.json').read_text())['utc'],
    'compared_count': len(compared), 'compared_passed': [k for k in compared if verdicts[k]['comparison']['passed']],
    'compared_failed': [k for k in compared if not verdicts[k]['comparison']['passed']],
    'deferred_history': results['deferred_history'], 'unevaluated_after_second_miss': results['unevaluated'],
    'not_compared': [k for k in verdicts if 'comparison' not in v] if False else [k for k, v in verdicts.items() if 'comparison' not in v],
    'calibration_attempts': results['calibration_attempts'], 'verdicts': verdicts, 'groups': groups,
    'audit': {'complete_groups': len(groups), 'child_processes_in_complete_groups_including_warmup': children,
              'checked': 'sample counts, warmup exclusion, checksums, medians, delta, change, arm order, parent and live child affinity [2], verdicts, and SHA of inputs/binaries/evidence/worker/controller/protocol at audit time',
              'limits': ['A/A is not a clock accuracy proof or a confidence interval', 'Host load was not independently monitored',
                         'Hashes are checked at worker launch and at audit, not continuously']},
    'frozen': {'protocol_sha256': start['protocol_sha256'], 'controller_sha256': start['controller_sha256'], 'worker_sha256': start['worker_sha256'], 'binary_hashes': protocol['binary_hashes']},
    'decision': {'local': 'hold; Windows catch-nested-256 comparison exceeded the 5% cap in series 1', 'runtime_modified': False},
    'audit_source': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
}
out = r / 'docs/measurements/2026-11-17-partial-adoption-local-standard-results.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
archive = {'results': results, 'protocol': protocol, 'start': start, 'groups': raw,
           'configs': {p.name: json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(o.glob('*-config.json'))},
           'log': (base / 'run.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'),
           'sources': {n: (base / n).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for n in ('run.py', 'prepare.py', 'audit.py', 'local/worker.py')}}
gz = r / 'docs/measurements/2026-11-17-partial-adoption-local-standard-raw.json.gz'
gz.write_bytes(gzip.compress(json.dumps(archive, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'), mtime=0))
print('groups', len(groups), 'children', children, 'compared', len(compared), 'failed', summary['compared_failed'])
print('not compared', len(summary['not_compared']), '| sizes', out.stat().st_size, gz.stat().st_size)
